name: Google Cloud Load Balancing
description: Google Cloud Load Balancing is Google’s load balancing service for Google Cloud Platform. The Sumo Logic App for Google Cloud Load Balancing helps you monitor load balancing activity. The preconfigured dashboards provide insight into request locations and volume, response codes, and request and response data by load balancer.

children.name: Google Cloud Load Balancing - Overview
children.description: See an overview of Google Cloud Balancing activity, including request locations, browsers and operating systems used, error status codes, requests by load balancer, bytes sent and received, and message severity over time.

panels.name: Request Location
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/GCP/loadbalancing logName resource type data
| json "message.data.resource.type" as type
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\"" 
| where type = "http_load_balancer" and log_name matches "projects/*/logs/requests"
| json "message.data.resource.labels", "message.data.httpRequest" as labels, http_request
| json field=labels "project_id", "zone", "url_map_name" as project, zone, load_balancer
| json field=http_request "remoteIp" as remote_ip
| lookup latitude, longitude from geo://default on ip = remote_ip
| count by latitude, longitude
| sort _count

panels.name: Browsers and Operating Systems
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/GCP/loadbalancing data logName resource type userAgent
| json "message.data.resource.type" as type
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\"" 
| where type = "http_load_balancer" and log_name matches "projects/*/logs/requests"
| json "message.data.resource.labels", "message.data.httpRequest" as labels, http_request
| json field=labels "project_id", "zone", "url_map_name" as project, zone, load_balancer
| json field=http_request "userAgent" as user_agent
// Parse all fields above, then aggregate
| if (user_agent matches "*Windows *" OR user_agent matches "*Win32*" OR user_agent matches "*Win64*","Windows","") as OS 
| if (user_agent matches "*Macintosh*" OR user_agent matches "*Darwin/*" OR user_agent matches "*Mac OS*","MacOS",OS) as OS 
| if (user_agent matches "* CrOS *","Chrome OS",OS) as OS
| if (user_agent matches "*Linux*","Linux",OS) as OS 
| if (user_agent matches "*iPad*","iPad",OS) as OS 
| if (user_agent matches "*iPhone*","iPhone",OS) as OS 
|  if (user_agent matches "*Android*","Android",OS) as OS 
| if (user_agent matches "*Windows Phone*","Windows Phone",OS) as OS 
| if (OS == "","Other",OS) as OS 
| if (user_agent matches "Mozilla/*; rv:*)*","Mozilla","") as Browser
| if (user_agent matches "*MSIE*","Internet Explorer",Browser) as Browser 
| if (user_agent matches "*Firefox*","Firefox",Browser) as Browser 
| if (user_agent matches "*Safari*","Safari",Browser) as Browser 
| if (OS=="Android" AND user_agent matches "*WebKit*","WebKit",Browser) as Browser
| if ((OS=="iPhone" OR OS=="iPad") AND (user_agent matches "*Mobile/*" OR user_agent matches "*AppleWebKit*(KHTML*Gecko)*"),"Mobile Safari",Browser) as Browser
| if (browser == "" AND OS=="MacOS" AND user_agent matches "Mozilla/* (Macintosh;*(KHTML, like Gecko)*","Safari",Browser) as Browser 
| if (user_agent matches "*MobileSafari/*","Mobile Safari",Browser) as Browser
| if (user_agent matches "*Chrome*","Chrome",Browser) as Browser 
| if (user_agent matches "Opera*","Opera",Browser) as Browser 
| if (user_agent matches "Dolphin*","Dolphin",Browser) as Browser 
| if (Browser == "","Other",Browser) as Browser  
| count by OS,browser
| transpose row os column browser as *

panels.name: 4XX and 5XX Status Codes
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/GCP/loadbalancing data logName resource timestamp
| json "message.data.resource.type" as type
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\"" 
| where type = "http_load_balancer" and log_name matches "projects/*/logs/requests"
| json "message.data.resource.labels", "message.data.httpRequest" as labels, http_request
| json field=labels "project_id", "zone", "url_map_name" as project, zone, load_balancer
| json field=http_request "status" as status_code
| if(status_code matches "40*", 1, 0) as resp_400
| if(status_code matches "50*", 1, 0) as resp_500
| sum(resp_400) as tot_400, sum(resp_500) as tot_500 by load_balancer, project

panels.name: Requests by Load Balancer
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/GCP/loadbalancing logName resource "\"type\":\"http_load_balancer\""
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\"" 
| where log_name matches "projects/*/logs/requests"
| json "message.data.resource.labels", "message.data.httpRequest" as labels, http_request
| json field=labels "project_id", "zone", "url_map_name" as project, zone, load_balancer
| count as requests by load_balancer, project
| sort by requests

panels.name: Bytes Sent and Received
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/GCP/loadbalancing logName resource "\"type\":\"http_load_balancer\""
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\"" 
| where log_name matches "projects/*/logs/requests"
| json "message.data.resource.labels", "message.data.httpRequest" as labels, http_request
| json field=labels "project_id", "zone", "url_map_name" as project, zone, load_balancer
| json field=http_request "requestSize", "responseSize" as request_size, response_size
| sum(request_size) as bytes_sent, sum(response_size) as bytes_received by load_balancer, project
| bytes_sent + bytes_received as total_bytes
| sort by total_bytes
| fields -total_bytes

panels.name: Severity Over Time
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/GCP/loadbalancing logName resource "\"type\":\"http_load_balancer\""
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\"" 
| where log_name matches "projects/*/logs/requests"
| json "message.data.resource.labels", "message.data.severity" as labels, severity
| json field=labels "project_id", "zone", "url_map_name" as project, zone, load_balancer
| if (severity = "INFO", 1, 0) as info
| if (severity = "WARNING", 1, 0) as warn
| if (severity = "ERROR", 1, 0) as error
| if (severity = "CRITICAL", 1, 0) as crit
| if (severity = "ALERT", 1, 0) as alert
| if (severity = "EMERGENCY", 1, 0) as emergency
| timeslice 1h
| sum(info) as INFO, sum(warn) as WARNING, sum(error) as ERROR, sum(crit) as CRITICAL, sum(alert) as ALERT, sum(emergency) as EMERGENCY by _timeslice
| fillmissing timeslice(1h)

children.name: Google Cloud Load Balancing - Request Analysis
children.description: See information about request activity in Google Cloud Load Balancing, including request locations, requests by type over time, requests by load balancer over time, KBs sent and received by number of requests, and total requests by load balancer.

panels.name: Request Location
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/GCP/loadbalancing data logName resource type
| json "message.data.resource.type" as type
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\"" 
| where type = "http_load_balancer" and log_name matches "projects/*/logs/requests"
| json "message.data.resource.labels", "message.data.httpRequest" as labels, http_request
| json field=labels "project_id", "zone", "url_map_name" as project, zone, load_balancer
| json field=http_request "remoteIp" as remote_ip
| lookup latitude, longitude from geo://default on ip = remote_ip
| count by latitude, longitude
| sort _count

panels.name: Requests by Type Over Time
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/GCP/loadbalancing data logName resource timestamp
| json "message.data.resource.type" as type
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\"" 
| where type = "http_load_balancer" and log_name matches "projects/*/logs/requests"
| json "message.data.resource.labels", "message.data.httpRequest" as labels, http_request
| json field=labels "project_id", "zone", "url_map_name" as project, zone, load_balancer
| json field=http_request "requestMethod" as method
| timeslice 1h
| if (method = "GET", 1, 0) as get_requests
| if (method = "POST", 1, 0) as post_requests
| if (method = "PUT", 1, 0) as put_requests
| if (method = "DELETE", 1, 0) as delete_requests
| if (method = "PATCH", 1, 0) as patch_requests
| if (!(method = "GET" or method = "POST" or method = "PUT" or method = "DELETE" or method = "PATCH"), 1, 0) as other_requests
| sum(get_requests) as tot_get, sum(post_requests) as tot_post, sum(put_requests) as tot_put, sum(delete_requests) as tot_delete, sum(patch_requests) as tot_patch, sum(other_requests) as tot_other by _timeslice
| fillmissing timeslice(1h)

panels.name: KBs Sent, Received by Number of Requests
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/GCP/loadbalancing data logName resource type
| json "message.data.resource.type" as type
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\"" 
| where type = "http_load_balancer" and log_name matches "projects/*/logs/requests"
| json "message.data.resource.labels", "message.data.httpRequest" as labels, http_request
| json field=labels "project_id", "zone", "url_map_name" as project, zone, load_balancer
| json field=http_request "requestSize", "responseSize" as request_size, response_size
| timeslice 1h
| (response_size/(1024)) as kbytes1 | (request_size/(1024)) as kbytes2 
| count as num_requests, sum(kbytes1) as data_received, sum(kbytes2) as data_sent by _timeslice 
| sort _timeslice

panels.name: Requests by Load Balancer Over Time
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/GCP/loadbalancing data logName resource "\"type\":\"http_load_balancer\""
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\"" 
| where log_name matches "projects/*/logs/requests"
| json "message.data.resource.labels" as labels
| json field=labels "project_id", "zone", "url_map_name" as project, zone, load_balancer
| timeslice 1h
| count as requests by _timeslice, project, load_balancer
| transpose row _timeslice column load_balancer, project

_sourceCategory = Labs/GCP/loadbalancing data logName resource "\"type\":\"http_load_balancer\""

children.name: Google Cloud Load Balancing - Status Analysis
children.description: See information about the status of requests in Google Cloud Load Balancing, including status codes per project, over time, and by load balancer; location of 4xx and 5xx responses; and 4xx and 5xx responses by load balancer.

panels.name: Status Codes per Project
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/GCP/loadbalancing data logName resource "\"type\":\"http_load_balancer\""
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\"" 
| where log_name matches "projects/*/logs/requests"
| json "message.data.resource.labels", "message.data.httpRequest.status" as labels, status
| json field=labels "project_id", "zone", "url_map_name" as project, zone, load_balancer
| if(status matches "20*", 1, 0) as resp_200
| if(status matches "30*", 1, 0) as resp_300
| if(status matches "40*", 1, 0) as resp_400
| if(status matches "50*", 1, 0) as resp_500
| if(!(status matches "20*" or status matches "30*" or status matches "40*" or status matches "50*"), 1, 0) as resp_others
| sum(resp_200) as tot_200, sum(resp_300) as tot_300, sum(resp_400) as tot_400, sum(resp_500) as tot_500, sum(resp_others) as tot_others by project

panels.name: Status Codes Over Time
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/GCP/loadbalancing data logName resource timestamp 
| json "message.data.resource.type" as type
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\"" 
| where type = "http_load_balancer" and log_name matches "projects/*/logs/requests"
| json "message.data.resource.labels", "message.data.httpRequest" as labels, http_request
| json field=labels "project_id", "zone", "url_map_name" as project, zone, load_balancer
| json field=http_request "status" as status
| timeslice 1h
| if(status matches "20*", 1, 0) as resp_200
| if(status matches "30*", 1, 0) as resp_300
| if(status matches "40*", 1, 0) as resp_400
| if(status matches "50*", 1, 0) as resp_500
| if(!(status matches "20*" or status matches "30*" or status matches "40*" or status matches "50*"), 1, 0) as resp_others
| sum(resp_200) as tot_200, sum(resp_300) as tot_300, sum(resp_400) as tot_400, sum(resp_500) as tot_500, sum(resp_others) as tot_others by _timeslice

children.name: Google Cloud Load Balancing Recent Requests

search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/GCP/loadbalancing data logName resource timestamp
| json "message.data.resource.type" as type
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\"" 
| where type = "http_load_balancer" and log_name matches "projects/*/logs/requests"
| json "message.data.resource.labels", "message.data.httpRequest", "message.data.timestamp" as labels, http_request, timestamp
| json field=labels "project_id", "zone", "url_map_name" as project, zone, load_balancer
| json field=http_request "requestMethod", "remoteIp", "responseSize", "requestSize", "status" as method, remote_ip, bytes_sent, bytes_received, status
| count as messages by timestamp, load_balancer, project, zone, remote_ip, method, status, bytes_sent, bytes_received
| fields -messages
| sort by timestamp
